name: MonliPay
tagline: Send tokens with a link. Pay one person or share a pool with a group.
problem: Sending crypto usually starts with exchanging wallet addresses. Group distributions add repeated transfers, recipient lists, and manual tracking.
solution: MonliPay turns a funded token transfer into a link shared in an existing chat. Payment Links pay one recipient. Group Payments split a pool into equal amounts or random shares, open to anyone or selected wallets, with one share per wallet and an expiry refund. Equal shares settle in one claim transaction. Private Payment adds an optional AnomaPay transfer on Monad mainnet. Contacts save repeat recipients. Passkeys open browser-encrypted saved links.
existing_baseline: Commit 5544bf7: LinkVault payment links, bridge integration, Ponder indexer, and existing wallet support predate this Metropolis work. MonliPay is an extension of an existing project.

limits: Public Payment and Group Payment claims require network gas. Random Group Payment also requires a variable MON oracle fee. Public gas sponsorship is disabled.
Private claims deduct a protocol fee from the link balance. The receiving wallet does not need MON for that relayed withdrawal. MON funding wraps to WMON and the recipient receives WMON.

Private Payment is beta and mainnet-only. Transfers inside AnomaPay are shielded from public chain observers; deposits, withdrawals and correlation remain visible risks. Proving operators receive plaintext witness data. This is not complete anonymity.
Private links have no expiry or automatic refund. The sender or any other holder can reclaim an unspent link; the first successful spend wins.
Only WMON has funded private end-to-end validation. Mainnet stablecoin transfers were not exercised.

Wallet eligibility is not proof of one human per wallet. Passkey PRF support depends on the browser and provider, and lost passkeys cannot be reset. No independent security audit or enterprise certification is claimed.
The 80-second transaction demo uses Monad testnet and an automated dedicated wallet; the added 24-second privacy interface walkthrough is explicitly separate from the real funded mainnet pilot.
Group Payment pools have a fixed quota and expiry; they cannot be topped up or reused. The existing demo predates Equal Group Payment. No consumer user-testing results have been provided.
submission_status: Not submission-complete. Group contracts verified and frontend rollout in progress. Current public GitHub branch, accepted-platform technical demo URL, founder pitch video and human user-testing evidence remain outstanding. Portal submission has not been sent.
judge_quickstart: Open https://testnet.monlipay.xyz/create/group with a Monad testnet wallet. Both sender and recipient need faucet MON for gas. Select Equal amount for a fixed share, or Random amount for a Pyth draw. Anyone accepts first-come wallets; Selected wallets restricts eligibility.
Open https://monlipay.xyz/my-links, verify your wallet and use a PRF-compatible passkey to open encrypted links. Contacts use the wallet signature session.

Explore https://monlipay.xyz/create/private on mainnet. Connect a wallet and set up a passkey before funding. Review fees and privacy limits. No mainnet spend is necessary to review the already-published pilot receipts.
Source archive supplements the repository requirement: https://monlipay.xyz/submission/monlipay-metropolis-source-group-20261013.zip. Current GitHub publication must still be completed.
